about: Synthetic AI evaluation set for the case-note generator (ai_generate_case_note). Every name, date and detail is made up. Each case lists facts the note must keep, details it must not invent, the homework the notes imply, and whether the notes leave a gap the generator should flag (a question or a [bracketed] placeholder). Run: php tests/ai_eval/run.php (scores the sample replies in fixtures/, offline) or php tests/ai_eval/run.php --live --inc=<docroot>/inc --actor=<staff user id> on a test install with AI turned on.
